title: Apache Struts2 S2-061 Forced OGNL Evaluation
description: A Struts2 2.5.25 application, vulnerable to S2-061 (CVE-2020-17530): the page sets a tag attribute from the id parameter with %{...}, forcing a second OGNL evaluation of user input; a payload that sidesteps the S2-059 sandbox runs commands.
question: Exploit S2-061 through the id parameter to run commands on the Struts2 server and get a shell.
